title: All Weather Finance
tagline: The first auto-rebalancing RWA that tokenises S&P stocks, gold and bonds. Customise RWAs investments

prizes.title: Hedera EVM: Smart Contracts & Cross‑Chain Integrations

description:
All Weather Finance is an auto-rebalancing RWA that combines tokenised S&P 500 stocks, gold and bonds into a single diversified portfolio. Unlike other RWA tokens, investors can rebalance asset allocations for customised investment strategies. Accessible 24/7 with no intermediaries or large capital requirements, “All Weather RWAs” makes blue-chip investing open to anyone. Different Investors Different Needs!

Mission / Vision
A future where blue-chip asset classes like the S&P 500, gold, U.S. real estate, and sector ETFs are readily available on-chain, tradable 24/7, and accessible to anyone for creating diversified portfolios with no barriers to entry.

Problems Solved
All Weather RWAs tackles three persistent frictions that keep real‑world assets out of reach for most investors:
1 Limited Global Access to Blue-Chip RWAs
Problem: Today, most investors cannot access assets like the S&P 500, U.S. bonds, or commodities without intermediaries and regional restrictions.
Solution: All Weather RWAs lowers barriers by tokenizing these major asset classes into a single ETF that anyone can buy 24/7 with no brokers or large capital requirements.

2 Static RWA Tokens Don’t Adapt
Problem: Current RWA projects tokenize single assets (like T-Bills) or static baskets. This leaves investors exposed to volatility when one asset underperforms.
Solution: Our ETF auto-rebalances across equities, bonds, gold, periodically adjusting weights to hedge downturns and deliver smoother long-term performance.

3 Lack of Transparency & Trust and simple to track and easy to consume
 Problem: Without proof of reserves, verifiable audits, and KYC options, RWAs struggle to scale into a regulated and trusted investment product.
Solution: All Weather RWAs integrates Proof of Reserves for independent audits, and KYC using HTS-complaince layer, ensuring both transparency and regulatory readiness.
how_its_made:
1 Hedera
Handles tokenization, compliance, and lifecycle management of your RWA ETF tokens. Contracts are deployed on Hedera and HTS is used for mint/burn tokens supported by compliance.
2 Pyth Network
Provides real-time, reliable on-chain price feeds for all underlying asset classes in your all-season RWA ETF.
3 Tech Stack
allweatherfi-frontend React + TypeScript frontend
allweatherfi-backend NestJS backend API
allweatherfi-contracts Solidity smart contracts
